NeRF (Neural Radiance Fields) is a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes. Here are some videos generated by this repository (pre-trained models are provided below): This project is a faithful PyTorch implementation of NeRF that reproduces the results while running 1.3 times faster.
